{"command":"gh pr create --base main --head finish-phase0 --title "Add CI, rewrite the documentation from keys.go" --body-file - <<'EOF'
Closes the last two Phase 0 items of the roadmap.

## CI
`.github/workflows/ci.yml` runs on every push, and on pull requests from forks (a PR from a branch of this repo is already covered by its push):

- **lint:** gofmt, `go vet`, golangci-lint v2.14 with the standard linters (`.golangci.yml`). The only exclusion is unchecked `Close`, so an unchecked `os.Remove` still fails.
- **test:** `go test -race`. It mounts a tmpfs as `TWIN_XDEV_DIR`, so `TestMoveAcrossRealDevices` does a real move across filesystems, and fails if that test skips.

Clearing the lint findings:
- removes four unused styles and a dead assignment in the resize handler;
- applies a few staticcheck suggestions;
- makes the clipboard fallback report a failed OSC 52 write instead of dropping it.

## Documentation
- `DOCUMENTATION.md` is rewritten from `keys.go` and the code. It covers every shortcut and the keys of each popup, what copy, move and delete do (including what is left behind when they fail), and the known limitations. The old version said Alt+I selects files.
- `docs_test.go` fails when the shortcut table and `keys.go` disagree: a missing, extra or duplicated row, or a wrong F-key. This holds until the actions registry (Phase 1) generates the docs.
- README gets a CI badge and the development commands; CLAUDE.md and the roadmap are updated to match.

## Testing
Run locally: gofmt, `go vet`, golangci-lint v2.14, `TWIN_XDEV_DIR=/dev/shm go test -race ./...` and actionlint on the workflow all pass. I also checked that `docs_test.go` fails on a broken table and that golangci-lint flags an unchecked `os.Remove`. This PR's own CI run is the first time the workflow runs on GitHub.
